**Finding: missing** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

**What I checked**
- `sec-p0001` / `sec-1.4`: HDI designs, develops, hosts and bears all costs of the Site (p0005–p0007); we supply all Content (p0016); HDI collects and exports order data (p0010).
- `sec-5.4`: exclusivity and our limited Marks licence to HDI (p0038–p0039), confidentiality (p0048–p0054), general provisions including the no-joint-venture/co-ownership disclaimer (p0061–p0062) and assignment-of-agreement clause (p0063).
- Searches for "own", "intellectual property", "assign" and "Content", plus a definition lookup for "Content" — no defined term, and no IP ownership provision anywhere in the document.

**Assessment**
There is no ownership or assignment-of-IP clause at all. Nothing states who owns the developed Site, the Deerskin imagery/Content, or the customer and order data flowing through the Site. Section 8 (confidentiality) restricts HDI's *use and disclosure* of our Content and user information but does not establish ownership; Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control; Section 10.2's co-ownership language addresses the parties' relationship, not IP. Importantly, there is **no** assignment of our IP or data to HDI and no joint ownership created, so this is not walk-away territory — it is simply absent, and the rule expects a clause.

**Proposed redline (validated ok:true)** — new Section 5.5 inserted after p0035, at the preferred position:
- We retain all right, title and interest in the Content, the Marks and all customer/user/order data from the Site;
- HDI assigns the Site and other deliverables/work product to us, expressly carving out its pre-existing platform, tools and know-how;
- HDI grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any HDI materials embedded in or needed to use the deliverables;
- No transfer of our IP/data to HDI and no joint ownership.

The comment flags the licence-back-only approach as our available fallback if HDI insists on retaining its generic tooling. Confidence: 0.82.
